title: Per Question Marking Test
description: Each question has its own point value.

questions.question: What is the capital of Italy?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: Rome is the capital and largest city of Italy.

questions.question: How many states are in the USA?
questions.subject: Politics
questions.explanation: There are 50 states in the union.

questions.question: Which of these are European countries?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: France, Spain, and Germany are in Europe. Brazil is in South America.

questions.question: What is 7 squared?
questions.subject: Math

questions.question: Who developed the theory of relativity?
questions.subject: Physics
questions.explanation: Einstein published the special and general theories of relativity.

questions.question: Which of these are mammals?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Whales, dolphins, and bats are mammals. Sharks are fish.

questions.question: How many minutes are in an hour?
questions.subject: General
questions.explanation: There are 60 minutes in one hour.

questions.question: What is the largest land animal?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: The African bush elephant is the largest living land animal.

questions.question: Which of these are fruits?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Botanically, tomatoes are fruits.

questions.question: How many edges does a cube have?
questions.subject: Math
questions.explanation: A cube has 12 edges.

questions.question: Who was known as the 'Maid of Orleans'?
questions.subject: History
questions.explanation: Joan of Arc is a heroine of France for her role during the Lancastrian phase of the Hundred Years' War.

questions.question: Which of these are chemical elements?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: Iron and Oxygen are elements. Plastic is a polymer, and Water is a compound.

questions.question: How many players are in a basketball team on court?
questions.subject: Sports
questions.explanation: Basketball is played with 5 players per team on the court.

questions.question: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: The Japanese yen is the official currency of Japan.

questions.question: Which of these were written by George Orwell?
questions.subject: Literature
questions.explanation: 1984 and Animal Farm are his most famous works.

questions.question: What is the value of Pi to two decimal places?
questions.subject: Math
questions.explanation: Actually, the integer part is 3. (Instruction asks for Integer type).

questions.question: Who is the god of the sea in Greek mythology?
questions.subject: History
questions.explanation: Poseidon is the god of the sea, earthquakes, and horses.

questions.question: Which of these are noble metals?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: Noble metals resist corrosion and oxidation.

questions.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Octopuses have three hearts.

questions.question: What is the largest country in the world by land area?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: Russia is the largest country, spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia.

questions.question: Which of these are planets?
questions.subject: Science
questions.explanation: Mars and Venus are planets. The Moon is a satellite and the Sun is a star.

questions.question: How many colors are in a rainbow?
questions.subject: Science
questions.explanation: Traditional sequence is Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital city of Australia.

questions.question: Which of these are operating systems?
questions.subject: Tech
questions.explanation: Windows, Linux, and macOS are OSs. Word is an application.

questions.question: What is the atomic number of Hydrogen?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the first element in the periodic table.
